data.one_liner: Embeddable NoSQL database with typo-tolerant full-text search.
data.what_it_does: Mimir provides an embedded NoSQL database for Dart and Flutter based on Meilisearch. It allows storing documents and performing fast, typo-tolerant full-text searches and declarative queries.
use_when: You need typo-tolerant and relevant full-text search locally on device
You want declarative and reactive NoSQL queries
avoid_when: You are building for the Mac App Store and need macOS App Sandbox enabled
You only need simple key-value storage and want to minimize binary size
You need to open multiple indexes simultaneously on iOS devices
strengths: Built-in typo-tolerant full-text search with zero extra configuration
Reactive streams for queries and documents
Cross-platform support across mobile and desktop
weaknesses: Cannot be used with macOS App Sandbox
Only one index can be opened on iOS devices
data.setup_notes: Requires installing rustup on the development computer and disabling App Sandbox for macOS apps.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a traditional relational SQLite database.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a robust, type-safe reactive SQL database builder for Flutter.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want direct bindings to SQLite.
